runs.label: phase7-normal-r2
command: import sys, pathlib, unittest, phase3; expected=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); print('IMPORTED_RUNNER',phase3.__file__,flush=True); print('OPTIMIZE',sys.flags.optimize,flush=True); exec("if pathlib.Path(phase3.__file__).resolve()!=expected/'phase3.py': raise RuntimeError('runner import drift')"); import importlib.util; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('combined_test_phase3', expected/'test_phase3.py'); test_phase3=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(test_phase3); print('IMPORTED_TEST',test_phase3.__file__,flush=True); result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(test_phase3)); sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and result.testsRun==37 else 1)
